title: Mans Carpio’s spox to Philip Lustre: Don’t play the victim

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The spokesman of Atty. Manases “Mans” Carpio, husband of Vice President Sara Duterte, told journalist Philip Lustre not to play the victim, saying he would not be facing a cyberlibel case if he had not made “malicious” and “baseless” remarks against the Duterte family. “If he hadn’t posted something malicious and baseless, he wouldn’t be facing a lawsuit,” said Atty. Neil Abayon, Carpio’s spokesman. “So don’t play the victim,” he added. Lustre is known as a vocal critic of the Duterte family.
